data.name: Maalikah
data.gender_notes: Maalikah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Maalikah means 'Lady' or 'Ruler'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'Mulk', which refers to dominion or sovereignty. In Islamic tradition, Maalikah is a title of honor for the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) wife, Aisha (ra). The name Maalikah carries the meaning “Lady, Ruler” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maalikah usually hope their child will grow to embody lady, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
